skyweave_compat.configuration.title: Skyweave: Compatibility Patches

skyweave_compat.config.minimumIslandRadi: Minimum native radius of the host island. This does not change island generation.

skyweave_compat.ponder.linear_assembly.t: Linear Casings form a passive guide. Match the bearing and casing orientations.
Glue the payload together above the bearing.
Right-click the bearing with an empty hand to assemble the payload.
The bearing becomes a casing. The assembled carriage can slide along matching rails.
skyweave_compat.ponder.linear_brake.head: Moving and Braking a Carriage
skyweave_compat.ponder.linear_brake.text: Gravity or an external force moves the carriage. The guide supplies no driving power.
Redstone power on the moving carriage engages its brake at the current position.
Remove power to release the brake. Keep any powered drive separate from the brake circuit.
skyweave_compat.ponder.linear_recovery.t: Engage the brake and align the payload with the block grid before recovery.
Right-click the casing with an empty hand to recover one aligned, braked carriage.
Recovery preserves the payload. Occupied spaces or a misaligned carriage prevent it.
Recover the assembly before removing the rails you intend to reuse.
skyweave_compat.ponder.linear_magnetic.t: Place two Magnetic Ports facing each other across a clear gap.
Supply rotation through a rear shaft. The facing port transfers it to the receiving network.
The source supplies the connected load. Overloading it stalls the network.
Magnetic Ports transfer rotation. They do not pull a carriage like Aeronautics' Redstone Magnets.
skyweave_compat.ponder.linear_spring.tex: Torsional Anchors transfer rotation through a spring connection.
Place a Spring Head in front of each anchor, then connect the two heads.
Drive one anchor from a kinetic network. The linked anchor carries its rotation and load.
This is a rotational connection, not a motor that extends a linear carriage.
skyweave_compat.ponder.linear_gyro.text_: Mount the Gyroscopic Gearbox on a simulated body to measure its angular velocity.
Its shaft signal follows rotation about the selected axis. It has no stress capacity and supplies no driving power.
A Redstone Converter reads one signal level per 8 RPM, up to 15. Use the signal in a separate control circuit.
When the body stops rotating, the sensor returns to zero. It does not hold an angle or stabilize the body.
